newsitem.title: USA: Metal Management to restate Q2 results.
newsitem.headline: Metal Management to restate Q2 results.

text.p: Metal Management Inc said Thursday it will restate September 30 second-quarter results for an accounting error at its EMCO Recycling Corp subsidiary.
The error resulted in an understatement of net loss of the quarter of about $368,000 or $0.04 per share, it said.
Previously, Metal Management reported a loss for the quarter of $400,000 or $0.045 per share on revenuues of $14 million.
It said the accounting error occurred as a result of system processing problems encountered as EMCO implemented a new management information system in September 1996.
